request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: three parallel curved claw slash marks raking diagonally from upper left to lower right. Frames 1 to 3: the three glowing red-orange claw streaks appear one after another, each with a white-hot core. Frames 4 to 8: they blaze at full brightness with sparks and drops of glowing ember flying off them. Frames 9 to 16: the streaks break apart into embers, fade and dim until the last frame is nearly black. Bold saturated red, orange and white.
